# Discoveries

Hidden places and sights. Each one found gives exploration EXP and counts toward its region's mastery.

Exploration EXP by discovery size: common 10, rare 30, major 100.

| Exploration level | EXP | Reward |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 20 | - |
| 2 | 50 | 500 mesos |
| 3 | 90 | [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x5 |
